t: This is Lioness and Lesser Kudu, a sculpture in Grosvenor Gardens. It's by Jonathan Kenworthy, a British sculptor born in 1943 who is a Fellow of the Royal Society of British Sculptors. The title names two animals, so look for both of them and how the artist has arranged them together. I don't have more detail about the story behind the piece, so take your time and look at how the figures relate to each other, and to the gardens around them.
